name: @atropical/stroq-studio-mcp

tools.name: studio_connection
tools.description: Whether a Strōq World Studio tab is connected to this relay. When none is, it gives the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to tell the person: in the Studio, Tools → AI agent → Connect…, paste it, switch Connect on. The Studio tools appear once the tab connects.

tools.name: wait_for_comments
tools.description: Waits for comments and Asks from the person in the Studio and returns them; works before the tab has paired too (it waits for the pairing first). Returns within 45 s; "nothing new" means call it again. Use it as a loop: handle each one (ack_comment, get_comment, do the work, reply_comment), then call wait_for_comments again. Keep calling it even if the tab disconnects (it resumes by itself); only stop when the person tells you to.

instructions: Tools of an open Strōq World Studio tab, relayed. If no tab is connected yet, call studio_connection and tell the person the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to paste under Tools → AI agent → Connect…. This agent owns the Studio's comments and Asks, and the person expects answers without prompting you again: Call wait_for_comments, and keep calling it in a loop: each call returns within about 50 s, either with the comments and Asks waiting (for each: ack_comment straight away, get_comment for the picture and thread, do the work, reply_comment saying what changed) or with "nothing new", and then you call it again. Keep calling it even if the Studio tab disconnects or reloads (it resumes by itself); only stop when the person tells you to. When you create a model for the Studio, always make and send a low-poly version too (import_model_file lowPolyPath: a flat-coloured, ~1–2k triangle version of the same object), and never show the person temporary file paths.
